title: Spiderweb-PR Spatial Boundary Registry
description: Four distinct boundary objects for the Puerto Rico regional scene: PR_CORE_BOUNDARY (terrestrial/insular core), PR_EEZ_LEGAL_BOUNDARY (legal maritime reference), SPIDERWEB_ANALYTICAL_DOMAIN (technical clipping/rendering extent), CONTEXT_BUFFER (buffer policy around the analytical domain). These are deliberately kept separate — see notes on each entry. A boundary with status='unresolved' MUST have geometry=null: this registry records what has NOT been sourced yet as honestly as what has.

geometry.description: Small inline GeoJSON (e.g. a bbox) for simple/provisional cases. For real sourced boundary data, use geometry_ref instead — large geometry belongs in a regenerable data/ file, not this committed config (see docs/DATA_POLICY.md). Must be null when status is unresolved.

geometry_ref.description: Repo-relative path to a GeoJSON file (under data/, gitignored, produced by an ingestion script — see server/ingestion/) holding the actual boundary geometry. Must be null when status is unresolved.
